summary: Alterity Therapeutics Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, submitting an exhibit for the quotation of securities (ATH). The filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer, incorporating by reference previous registration statements. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is described.
